title: Mathematica Summer Camp 2012
text:
Mathematica Summer Camp is a 12-day program for students entering grades 11-12. The program is intensive; students will learn Mathematica programming as well as attend lectures on higher level math. Students work on individual projects as well. The daily schedule starts at 7:45am with breakfast, morning session from 8:30-10, project time from 10-12, afternoon session from 1-2pm, and more project time from 2:10-3:45pm. There is a guest speaker every evening. The cost in 2014 is $2070.

You can find out more here: www.mathematica-camp.org/about.html
